Other risks could include things like supply chain disruptions, geopolitical tensions, or natural disasters, which are difficult to predict but could meaningfully influence the outcome. Conversely, even more gradual changes, like shifts in market sentiment or adjustments to long-term growth expectations, could nudge the variable outside the anticipated range if they were sharp enough or sustained over time.
